analysis_scope: Exploratory post-processing of saved training minibatch losses only; no new training or evaluation.
comparison_direction: later-window mean minus earlier-window mean; negative means the logged own-objective average fell
window_definition: Fractions of planned_steps; include logged steps at or above the lower bound and strictly below the upper bound.
statistical_unit: training seed, n=3 for each corpus and training objective
multiplicity: Unadjusted, exploratory comparisons; primary and sensitivity windows are all reported, with no selection of the best-looking window.
limitations: Logged points measure different minibatches, not a fixed training or held-out evaluation set.
Within-curve minibatches are not independent experiment replications; slope standard errors and minibatch-based p-values are not reported.
Three-seed bootstrap intervals are discrete empirical summaries, not reliable coverage guarantees; they exclude data, architecture, schedule, and tuning uncertainty.
The bootstrap interval is not an inversion of the sign-flip test; the smallest attainable two-sided sign-flip p-value is 0.25 for three nonzero differences.
Cross-entropy and Brier training objectives have different scales; their raw magnitudes, slopes, and percentage changes must not be compared as learning-speed measures.
No intermediate held-out metrics are present, so these curves cannot identify equal-quality arrival times, a converged minimum, or an asymptotic ordering.

logging_semantics.loss_measurement: Mean selected training objective over one minibatch: eight sequences, each with 255 next-token targets, total 2040 targets.
logging_semantics.timing: Loss computed before the update at zero-based step j; the pre-update value is appended after opt.step().
logging_semantics.logging_frequency: Every 100 steps, plus the final zero-based step.
logging_semantics.retention: Only the last 400 points are retained in final validation records; test records intentionally have empty curves.
logging_semantics.schedule: 500-step linear warmup to the selected peak 0.0003, then cosine decay toward 0.1 times that peak (0.00003).
logging_semantics.held_out_metrics: Validation/test metrics are evaluated at the end of each run only; tuning endpoints are separate runs with shorter schedules.

plot_smoothing.method: Nonoverlapping 2000-step bins anchored at step 0; mean of logged losses within each bin, plotted at mean logged step; then an equally weighted mean across three seeds.
plot_smoothing.uncertainty_band: none; individual seed traces show seed variability

protocol.initialization: embedding normal std 0.02, no output bias, no collapsed coordinate
protocol.rule: same 118032360 final tokens as the WikiText-103 run

last_10_percent_vs_previous_10_percent.sign_flip_null: seed-level differences are symmetric about zero; signs are exchangeable
